## 2 Â· The extension's own tools (registered once, by the door)



## 2 Â· The extension's own tools (registered once, by the door)



**One tool, ONE registration.** Another extension imports the shared lib; it never re-registers
a tool another already registers (plan 66 Part 8, register Â§12).

## 3 Â· The uncovered jobs â€” where a new script would otherwise appear

Anything **uncalled** in Â§1 is a job with no door an agent can find. Two honest answers, never a
third:
1. **it is a real capability** â†’ add a row here with its door and its tech decision, or
2. **it is retired** â†’ move the file to `hodd/reference/` and say why (Rule 11).

## 4 Â· The rule for new work

```
one_capability[4]{rule,means}:
  "one name","a capability has ONE name and ONE door; two doors is a bug the seat check names"
  "thin doors","the door calls bin/ so a human and a cron row run the same thing"
  "state before content","a door may be 1 line; anything with parsing or state moves to src/"
  "no unlisted scripts","a new bin/*.sh needs a row here, or it does not ship"
```
